events.title: Ledger Live renamed Ledger Wallet
events.description: Ledger transitioned the companion application branding from Ledger Live to Ledger Wallet.

events.title: Ledger Live launched as Ledger companion application
events.description: Ledger launched Ledger Live as a new all-in-one companion application for Ledger devices on Windows, Mac, and Linux. The same product lineage was later renamed Ledger Wallet in 2025.
events.notes: This launch event belongs to the existing Ledger Wallet product lineage, which retains Ledger Live as a historical alias. The later 2025 rebrand event remains separate.
